div.head: Iud Dei II 1
div.ab: In simplo unum pondus, in triplo tria ferrum aequiperet pondera.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 406 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: 1—1, 2 umgeordnet auch in Tr; s. u. XIᵇ. Dieser Satz, in England (gemäss Hu. 9; Blas. 1, oben S. 388) dem ursprünglich festländischen Ritual nur vorangesetzt (vgl. oben I 1ᵉ), stimmt nicht dazu: er denkt wie 5, 1 nur an das Tragen des Glüheisens, dagegen dieses auch an dessen Beschreitung 2, 6. 4, 1

1—1, 2 also rearranged in Tr; see below XIᵇ. This sentence, which in England (according to Hu. 9; Blas. 1, above p. 388) was merely placed in front of the originally continental ritual (cf. above I 1ᵉ), does not fit it: like 5, 1, it has in mind only the carrying of the red-hot iron, whereas the ritual also has in mind walking on it, 2, 6. 4, 1
above it in black gelice H

div.ab: In the single ordeal let the iron weigh one pound, in the triple three pounds.
